capabilities.implementation: FederatedLearningEngine (FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD)
capabilities.known_limitations: Communication rounds bounded in memory; multi-datacenter network jitter emulated locally.

capabilities.implementation: FedAdam, FedYogi, FedAdagrad, Q-FedAvg server-side momentum algorithms
capabilities.known_limitations: Requires careful tuning of server learning rate eta_g and epsilon damping under Non-IID skew.

capabilities.implementation: Opacus DP-SGD with PRVAccountant and Renyi DP moments accounting
capabilities.known_limitations: Severe utility collapse (NR-001) under strong noise sigma >= 3.0 (epsilon <= 0.35); operational trade-off required.

capabilities.implementation: Pairwise additive zero-sum masking with HKDF domain separation
capabilities.known_limitations: Evaluated in local and in-memory multi-node harnesses; full distributed threshold key reconstruction depends on network layer.

capabilities.implementation: TenSEAL CKKS vector encryption for homomorphic parameter summation
capabilities.known_limitations: High computational overhead limits practical application to parameter vector aggregations; full homomorphic inference not implemented.

capabilities.implementation: SoftwareEmulatedTEEDriver with HMAC-SHA256 measurement attestation
capabilities.known_limitations: Physical bare-metal Intel SGX / AMD SEV hardware not exercised; must not claim physical silicon attestation.

capabilities.implementation: Coordinate Trimmed Mean, Coordinate Median, Multi-Krum, Bulyan
capabilities.known_limitations: Tolerates up to f < n/2 (Trimmed Mean) or f < (n-2)/2 (Krum); incurs clean-data utility penalty (NR-005) under Non-IID Dirichlet skew.

capabilities.implementation: Canonical preprocess_transaction() reference preprocessor
capabilities.known_limitations: Strict ordinal-encoding with constant feature order; unknown categorical values map to category zero or nearest alias.

capabilities.implementation: PyTorch CPU neural forward pass with fail-closed exception handling
capabilities.known_limitations: Inference runs on CPU; multi-GPU Triton serving clusters not exercised.

capabilities.implementation: ModelRegistry and ModelEvaluationEngine with immutable version binding
capabilities.known_limitations: Storage relies on local directory structure; external S3/MinIO artifact repository is optional.

capabilities.implementation: StreamingGraphService and UBOGraphService with topological cycle detection
capabilities.known_limitations: Event-time as_of filtering bounded by window memory; perfect immutable bi-temporal node replay not guaranteed.

capabilities.implementation: PyTorch Geometric Inductive GraphSAGE with neighbor sampling
capabilities.known_limitations: Evaluated on Elliptic Bitcoin graph (AP: 0.3761); full cross-bank federated GraphSAGE remains an experimental prototype.

capabilities.implementation: Temporal as_of filtering on graph edges and transaction events
capabilities.known_limitations: Supports filtering transactions by timestamp; does not maintain full immutable bi-temporal node state snapshots.

capabilities.implementation: Surrogate KernelExplainer (bounded permutations) and Local Heuristic Explainer
capabilities.known_limitations: Evaluates bounded permutation budget (N=100) for sub-50ms API SLAs; heuristics must not be claimed as exhaustive Shapley values.

capabilities.implementation: StreamingEngine with schema validation and async queue processing
capabilities.known_limitations: Operates over in-memory and WebSocket queues in local tests; physical Kafka broker cluster not deployed in test environment.

capabilities.implementation: FeatureStoreService with TTL-backed rolling velocity and baseline statistics
capabilities.known_limitations: Online lookups use in-memory store in local test environment; Feast Redis cluster is optional.

capabilities.implementation: IdempotencyService with (tenant_id, key) namespace partitioning and payload hashing
capabilities.known_limitations: Idempotency TTL provides bounded request idempotency (typically 24 hours), not permanent infinite uniqueness.

capabilities.implementation: Tenant-scoped database schemas, BOLA/IDOR prevention headers, and Vault transit keys
capabilities.known_limitations: Enforced in application layer and SQLite file partitions; physical cross-database VPC segregation requires cloud deployment.

capabilities.implementation: AlertService with composite risk scoring and deduplication keys
capabilities.known_limitations: Alert thresholds fixed a priori to prevent metric shopping.

capabilities.implementation: CaseManagementService with optimistic CAS version check and timeline hash chain
capabilities.known_limitations: Version increment strictly monotonic; terminal cases cannot receive further status modifications.

capabilities.implementation: Mandatory distinct supervisor sign-offs with self-approval prohibition

capabilities.implementation: FIURegulatoryService producing schema-validated XML 4.0 dossiers

capabilities.implementation: WebhookService with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, SSRF IP blocking, and exponential backoff
